svg.title: GKOS canonical informative architecture orientation
svg.desc: GKOS defines governance responsibilities, GKX is the interoperability seam, implementations are plural, retrieval and governance remain separate when retrieval is used, governed actions preserve L4 through L7 boundaries, receipts are cross-layer, external bindings are informative, and founder deployment examples are not part of the Standard.
svg.text: GKOS Canonical Architecture — informative · r3 · v0.82 development candidate
